passages.title: Lobby renovation
passages.text:
Dear Residents,

We are pleased to [1] that renovation of the lobby at Parkview Apartments will begin on August 5. The work is expected to take about three weeks and will [2] a new entrance door, improved lighting, and a larger mailroom. [3] Residents may use the side entrance on Elm Street during this time. Because construction can be noisy, we ask you to be [4] of your neighbors, especially before 9 A.M. and after 6 P.M.

Parkview Management

why.vi: Sau "pleased to" cần động từ nguyên mẫu: "announce".
why.en: After "pleased to" we need a base verb: "announce".

questions.trap: "announcement" là danh từ, không theo sau "to" ở đây.

why.vi: Sau "will" cần động từ nguyên mẫu: "include".

questions.trap: "including" nghe quen nhưng không đi trực tiếp sau "will".

options: Rent payments are due on the first day of each month.
The building was constructed more than thirty years ago.
The main entrance will be closed to the public throughout the project.
A new tenant will move into Apartment 4B next week.

why.vi: Câu sau cho phép dùng cửa phụ, nên câu trước phải nói cửa chính sẽ đóng.
why.en: The next sentence offers a side entrance, so the missing sentence says the main entrance will be closed.

questions.trap: Câu B nhắc tòa nhà nhưng không liên quan đến lối vào.

why.vi: "be considerate of" nghĩa là biết quan tâm đến người khác: cần tính từ sau "be".
why.en: "Be considerate of" means thoughtful toward others: an adjective after "be".

questions.trap: "consideration" là danh từ, đi với "show", không đi sau "be ... of" ở đây.
